name: umwelt
description: Workspace for Umwelt, an epistemic state engine.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @kallamo/umwelt && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.schema:generate: cargo run -p umwelt-core --bin generate-schema && cargo run -p umwelt-protocol --bin generate-protocol-schema
scripts.schema:check: cargo run -p umwelt-core --bin generate-schema -- --check && cargo run -p umwelt-protocol --bin generate-protocol-schema -- --check
scripts.test:csharp: cargo build -p umwelt-ffi && dotnet run -c Release --project bindings/csharp/Umwelt.Conformance
